objective: faiss::scalar_quantizer::QuantizerTemplate<Codec4bit<RISCV_RVV>, NON_UNIFORM, NONE>::decode_vector executes an entirely scalar per-component decode loop (0x7ac4a8-0x7ac4e8): packed 4-bit nibble unpack (srli/lbu/andi/sraw/andi 15), fcvt.s.w, fadd.s +0.5f, fdiv.s /15.0f, vmin/vdiff scalar loads, fmadd.s, fsw; 100% of the function's profile samples land in this loop and the interval contains zero v* instructions. No RVV decode kernel exists: sq-rvv.cpp defines Codec4bit/QuantizerTemplate<*,NON_UNIFORM,RISCV_RVV> as opaque markers that inherit the scalar NONE base and never override decode_vector (only DCTemplate distance-computers get RVV fast paths), so the runtime-dispatched QT_4bit path (sq-dispatch.h select) executes scalar code and the compiler did not autovectorize the packed-nibble arithmetic.

changes.rationale: Add a real VLEN-agnostic RVV decode_vector override to the QuantizerTemplate RISCV_RVV specializations in faiss/impl/scalar_quantizer/sq-rvv.cpp (NON_UNIFORM, and UNIFORM for consistency), mirroring the AVX2/AVX512 Codec4bit decode_8/16_components approach without any fixed width: strip-mined loop that loads vl/2 packed code bytes (vle8), unpacks low/high 4-bit nibbles (vand 0x0F / vsrl 4 or even-odd deinterleave), converts to float (vzext + vfwcvt.f.xu or vwf), applies the affine decode (0.5f*inv15 offset and inv15 scale via precomputed scalars), and fuses vmin[i]+vdiff[i]*x with vfmacc against contiguous vmin/vdiff vectors, ending with vse32 for the even/odd interleaved component order; keep fixed-VL main loop plus runtime-VL tail per kernel conventions and leave the scalar NONE base as the fallback for non-RVV builds.
instructions: The library is built with COMPILE_SIMD_RISCV_RVV (metadata shows rv64* v1p0/zvl128b build ISA)
Runtime SIMD dispatch in sq-dispatch.h selects SIMDLevel::RISCV_RVV for QT_4bit so the RVV tag-quantizer is reached
d can be any value including odd; tail must be handled VLEN-agnostically
